context: Temporal hierarchical edge bundling of a cross-department collaboration network over 12 months, with interactive month slider, bundling-strength slider, and hover-to-trace interactions.
first_impression: A well-structured network visualization that correctly uses scaleSqrt for node sizing and data-driven domains throughout.
what_works: Node radius uses d3.scaleSqrt with a globally data-driven domain (d3.max across all months), ensuring area-correct encoding and cross-month comparability; active edge filtering is temporally honest with clean startMonth/endMonth window logic.
what_doesnt: Edge colors encode source department only, so bi-directional edges are visually asymmetric without disclosure; the bundling slider conflates path routing aesthetics with data structure, which could be mistaken for showing different data rather than different rendering.
